title: Set up a recurring research specialist
goal: Create a specialist that produces the requested recurring research report

steps.title: Create the research specialist
steps.reason: Give this plan a worker with a reviewed role and instructions
steps.success_criterion: The approved specialist definition is installed

steps.title: Load the new setup
steps.reason: A new specialist loads when the team restarts; its tools then follow the access it is given
steps.success_criterion: The specialist is running with the approved setup

steps.title: Prepare the report
steps.reason: Search the web and read sources to answer the question

steps.title: Schedule future reports
steps.reason: Repeat the research on the agreed cadence without more access
steps.success_criterion: A schedule owned by the person has the agreed cadence

steps.title: Check the first scheduled report
steps.reason: Confirm the complete result, not just the setup
steps.success_criterion: The person received the first scheduled report

title: Prepare and publish an announcement
goal: Publish the reviewed announcement and check that it is live

steps.title: Link or reuse the account
steps.reason: The person chooses which account posts; linking gives no access by itself
steps.success_criterion: An account is linked to the posting tool

steps.title: Prepare the announcement
steps.reason: Write the text the person asked for
steps.success_criterion: The person agreed the exact text

steps.title: Publish this draft
steps.reason: Posting needs read-and-change access to X for this exact text

steps.title: Check the published post
steps.reason: Confirm the post exists before reporting success
steps.success_criterion: The post is visible with the agreed text

title: Read pages with a crawler
goal: Install the crawler MCP server, read pages with it and finish the requested report

steps.title: Install the crawler MCP server
steps.reason: The crawler is a proposed MCP server that is not installed yet; one review installs it and lets TeamArchitect use all its tools

steps.title: Read pages with the crawler
steps.reason: Reading pages is all the report needs; nothing is changed on the sites
steps.success_criterion: Pages are read with the crawler

steps.title: Finish and check the report
steps.reason: Confirm the complete result the person asked for
steps.success_criterion: The report uses the crawled pages and cites them
